meta.name: P I Meena
meta.description: Haunted by flashes of a tragic past, a private investigator, Meenakshi Iyer, aka P.I. Meena, starts investigating what seems like a routine hit-and-run case, only to discover that there's more to it than meets the eye and becomes entangled in a web of conspiracy that is tearing apart the worlds of everyone who comes close to it.

videos.title: The Sound of Metal
videos.overview: A brutal road accident that kills a young man. When the man’s mother, Chandana, tells Meenakshi that it wasn’t an accident and requests her to investigate it, Meenakshi refuses saying PI’s have no business investigating murders. But can she stay away?

videos.title: The Death Freeze
videos.overview: Still unsure, Meenakshi starts digging. She starts suspecting that the dead man was somehow linked to a mysterious virus outbreak in the village of Littnong, Eastern Himalayas.

videos.title: The Heart of Darkness
videos.overview: Now convinced that the young man was indeed killed, Meenakshi undertakes a reckless journey to Littnong, seeking to find the killer.

videos.title: The Pretender's Bluder
videos.overview: Meenakshi starts building her theory around the virus. Soon realises that her own life could be under threat.

videos.title: The Hidden Hazard
videos.overview: A virus starts breaking out around Kolkata. Meenakshi’s investigation picks up speed. A Central Intelligence officer warns Meenakshi to stay away from something that’s way beyond her comprehension.

videos.title: The Live Data
videos.overview: Kolkata is gripped by the virus outbreak. Meenakshi links the Kolkata virus to the Littnong one. Unknown to her, games are being played by her own accomplices about the identity of the virus. She must go back to Littnong to find some light.

videos.title: The Boat Called Ujaan
videos.overview: A few earth-shattering breakthroughs stab Meenakshi’s heart. She decides not to continue with her investigation any more only to be brought back to it by her friend. Because now it is not just a man’s death but the need to stop a genocide.

videos.title: The Reckless Sister
videos.overview: When Meenakshi finally cracks her case, she needs to act. And act she does. Most recklessly.
